jsb-queue-array.name: used shift to take the first item, but the order of the whole team did not change.

files.script.js: function rotateLast(queue) { if (queue.length) queue.unshift(queue.shift()); return queue; }

jsb-array-splice.name: Write the deletion quantity as 0, only insert new parts and leave old parts

files.script.js: function swapDevice(devices, index, replacement) { if (index >= 0 && index < devices.length) devices.splice(index, 0, replacement); return devices; }

jsb-array-slice-copy.name: Use splice to obtain the same return value, but change the original queue

jsb-array-find.name: returns an array after filtering, and the caller cannot read room directly.

files.script.js: function findRecord(records, serial) { return records.filter((item) => item.id === serial); }

jsb-array-quantifiers.name: puts some and every into opposite attributes

files.script.js: function attendance(states) { return { any: states.every(Boolean), all: states.some(Boolean) }; }

jsb-array-reduce.name: Add the input object directly to the total

files.script.js: function totalGrams(items) { return items.reduce((sum, item) => sum + item, 0); }

jsb-numeric-sort.name: uses the default dictionary order, and the order of single digits and two digits is wrong.

jsb-array-flatmap.name: only map results containing inner arrays

files.script.js: function participantNames(rooms) { return rooms.map((room) => room.names); }

jsb-object-dynamic-key.name: Use dot notation to read fixed literal field field

files.script.js: function readField(record, field) { return record.field ?? null; }

jsb-destructure.name: Use || to set the default value, and change the explicit 0 and null to 1

files.script.js: function tagFields({ name: title, count }) { return { title, quantity: count || 1 }; }

jsb-optional-chaining.name: Use || to connect the backup value, and the empty string is mistakenly replaced

files.script.js: function contactPhone(record) { return record?.contact?.phone || 'pending registration'; }

jsb-object-method.name: this in arrow method does not point to record

jsb-object-entries.name: uses Object.keys to spell out the name, but misses the quantity

files.script.js: function inventoryRows(inventory) { return Object.keys(inventory).map((name) => ({ name })); }

jsb-set-unique.name: Sort first and then remove duplicates, changing the order of first appearance

files.script.js: function uniqueCodes(codes) { return [...new Set(codes.toSorted())]; }

jsb-map-count.name: Ordinary objects inherit the prototype, and special keys cannot be used as ordinary material names for statistics.

jsb-classes.name: receive uses assignment instead of accumulation and loses the previous quantity.

jsb-date-iso.name: directly intercepts the input and ignores UTC cross-day

files.script.js: function archiveDay(timestamp) { return timestamp.slice(0, 10); }

jsb-regexp.name: Forgot to add the first and last boundaries, and the extra characters next to the correct encoding are also allowed.

files.script.js: function validLabel(text) { return /[A-Z]{2}-[0-9]{3}/.test(text); }

jsb-json-parse-errors.name: only captures exceptions, legal ordinary objects are also collected by mistake

files.script.js: function readChecklist(text) { try { return JSON.parse(text); } catch { return []; } }

jsb-debug-off-by-one.name: adds last + 1 to the end point, resulting in one more number being output.

jsb-palindrome.name: only uses trim and cannot ignore the spaces in the middle.

files.script.js: function isMirrorCode(text) { const code = text.trim().toLowerCase(); return code.length > 0 && code === [...code].reverse().join(''); }
